parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: The text this model is asked to find in the image.

parameters.name: boxes
parameters.description: Exemplar boxes: the object you mean, shown rather than named. A negative box says what it is not.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: Click points: one spot on the object, or one that is not it.

parameters.name: confidence_threshold
parameters.description: How sure the model must be before it reports an object.

parameters.name: imgsz
parameters.description: The square side the network runs at. A smaller one is faster and worse on small objects; a larger one runs at the ceiling and says so in `warnings`.
